points.description: States that the top of the stack is kept at the end of the array, so push and pop add/remove elements at that end (the right side / last element) of the array.
points.partial_credit: Half or so for a related but incomplete answer, e.g. says push/pop work on an array or use a top index/pointer but does not place the top at the end of the array.

rubric.notes: Full marks if the student says, in any wording, that push and pop happen at the end (right side) of the array, with the top at the end. Give part marks for vague or incomplete answers, such as describing an array with a top index but not saying which end. Give little or nothing for answers about unrelated things, and do not penalise extra remarks unless they contradict the core idea.
